answer.reason: Egypt is a whole land, but two events of Israel's story belong to it alone: the bondage and the striking of the firstborn.

clauses.english: was where the children of Israel were made to serve in hard bondage
clauses.quote: the Egyptians made the children of Israel to serve with rigour

clauses.english: had all its firstborn struck down by the LORD at midnight
clauses.quote: at midnight the LORD smote all the firstborn in the land of Egypt

doubts: Many other marked verses (Joseph's rule, the plagues, the Exodus, the prophecies against Egypt) were left out to keep to the two chief events.
